cues.en: I invented a new form of dithering.
cues.zh: 我发明了一种新的抖动方式。

cues.en: I call it surface stable, fractal dithering.
cues.zh: 我称之为“表面稳定的分形抖动”。

cues.en: What's unique about it is that the dots in the dithered patterns stick to surfaces,
cues.zh: 它的独特之处在于，抖动图案中的点会附着在表面上，

cues.en: and yet the dot sizes and spacing remain approximately constant on the screen even as surfaces move closer by or further away.
cues.zh: 而且即使表面移近或移远，点在屏幕上的大小和间距也基本保持不变。

cues.en: What's special about that and how does it work? That's what I'll dive into in this video.
cues.zh: 这有什么特别之处，它又是如何工作的？这就是我本期视频要深入探讨的内容。

cues.en: I'm Rune Skorpal Johansson,
cues.zh: 我是 Rune Skorpal Johansson，

cues.en: and this is Rune Edition.
cues.zh: 这里是 Rune Edition。

cues.en: Lucas Pope released the game Return of the Opera Den.
cues.zh: Lucas Pope 发布了游戏《Return of the Opera Den》。

cues.en: Besides being an excellent detective game, the best I've ever played in fact, it also had a novel aesthetic where the world is rendered entirely in black and white using image stillering to convey shades of gray.
cues.zh: 除了是一款出色的侦探游戏——事实上是我玩过最好的——它还采用了新颖的美术风格：整个世界完全以黑白渲染，并通过图像抖动来表现灰度层次。

cues.en: But let's take a step back.
cues.zh: 不过我们先退一步。

cues.en: Image stirring is a technique used in graphics to create the illusion of a higher number of shades than are actually used.
cues.zh: 图像抖动是图形学中的一种技术，用来制造出比实际使用的灰度层次更多的错觉。

cues.en: For example, to use only black and white pixels to create the impression of many shades of gray.
cues.zh: 比如，只用黑白像素来营造出多种灰度层次的观感。

cues.en: If you try to reduce a grayscale image to just black and white without using dithering,
cues.zh: 如果你想把灰度图像直接变成纯黑白，而不使用抖动，

cues.en: you have to choose a threshold where all pixels darker than this threshold become black and all pixels brighter than the threshold become white.
cues.zh: 你就得选一个阈值，凡是比这个阈值更暗的像素都变成黑，比阈值更亮的像素都变成白。

cues.en: No matter which threshold you choose, you end up losing most of the detail from the original image.
cues.zh: 无论你选哪个阈值，最终都会丢失原图的大部分细节。

cues.en: But what if we choose a random threshold for every pixel in the image?
cues.zh: 但如果我们为图像中的每个像素随机选一个阈值，会怎样？

cues.en: This is equivalent to first adding random noise to the image and then using a uniform threshold like before. And we can do that easily in an image editor.
cues.zh: 这等价于先给图像加上随机噪声，然后再像之前那样用一个统一的阈值。而这在图像编辑器里很容易做到。

cues.en: Now, granted, we do lose a lot of the finer detail here, but we are beginning to see the emergence of different shades of gray even though we are only using black and white pixels.
cues.zh: 当然，这里确实丢掉了不少细节，但我们已经开始看到不同灰度的显现，尽管用的仍然只有黑白两种像素。

cues.en: And we can do a lot better than just using random noise.
cues.zh: 我们可以比只用随机噪声做得好得多。

cues.en: There are many different image delivering algorithms divided into a few overall methods.
cues.zh: 图像抖动算法有很多种，可归为几大类方法。

cues.en: One method is called error diffusion.
cues.zh: 其中一种方法叫误差扩散。

cues.en: This method can produce the highest quality results for still images,
cues.zh: 这种方法对静态图像能产生最高质量的结果，

cues.en: but for moving images the dither patterns tend to change erratically
cues.zh: 但对于动态图像，抖动图案往往变化得不规则

cues.en: every frame,
cues.zh: 每一帧都这样，

cues.en: which makes it not suitable for my purposes.
cues.zh: 所以它不适合我的用途。

cues.en: Auto dithering is a different dithering method where values in the original image are compared with values in a tiled threshold map.
cues.zh: 自动抖动是另一种抖动方法，它将原始图像中的值与平铺阈值图中的值进行比较。

cues.en: We can test that in an image editor by adding the tiled threshold map to our image and then applying a threshold. Here, we're using a tiled threshold map known as an eight by eight Bayer matrix.
cues.zh: 我们可以在图像编辑器里测试：先把平铺阈值图叠加到图像上，再应用阈值。这里用的是平铺的 8×8 Bayer 矩阵作为阈值图。

cues.en: But we can use any pattern as our threshold map.
cues.zh: 但阈值图可以用任意图案。

cues.en: Here, we use a radial gradient and the result is essentially halftone dithering where we have big dots, generally many times the size of a single pixel with sizes that vary according to the brightness.
cues.zh: 这里我们用径向渐变，结果基本就是半色调抖动：得到大圆点，通常有单个像素的许多倍大，大小随亮度变化。

cues.en: When you use auto dithering on a moving image,
cues.zh: 在动态图像上使用自动抖动时，

cues.en: the result has a kind of pattern or texture to it which stems from the threshold map and which stays fixed on the screen.
cues.zh: 结果会带有一种图案或纹理，它源自阈值图，并在屏幕上保持固定。

cues.en: This can give a calmer appearance and error diffusion to the ring, but the dots still move relative to the moving imagery,
cues.zh: 这能让观感更平静，也能让误差扩散形成环状，但点仍会相对于运动图像移动，

cues.en: kind of sliding over it, which can still be a little bit distracting.
cues.zh: 有点像在上面滑动，仍可能有点分散注意力。

cues.en: Lucas Pope, who developed Return of the Opera Dinn wrote multiple posts about his considerations
cues.zh: 开发了 Return of the Obra Dinn 的 Lucas Pope 写过多篇帖子，谈他的考量

cues.en: for how to implement the delivering in the game.
cues.zh: 关于如何在游戏里实现抖动。

cues.en: Opera Dinn uses an upscale low res aesthetic which produces large chunky dithered patterns.
cues.zh: Opera Dinn 采用了一种高档的低分辨率美学，会产生大块粗颗粒的抖动图案。

cues.en: As previously touched upon, auto dithering is fixed with respect to the screen and is theoretically
cues.zh: 如前所述，自动抖动是相对于屏幕固定的，理论上

cues.en: more stable than error diffusion dithering.
cues.zh: 比误差扩散抖动更稳定。

cues.en: However, when the camera rotates,
cues.zh: 然而，当摄像机旋转时，

cues.en: so the geometry in the scene moves around in the camera's view, there's no connection between the geometry being rendered and the dither pattern that thresholds it. This produced conflicting visual cues as well as flickering
cues.zh: 场景中的几何体就会在摄像机视野中移动，此时被渲染的几何体与对它做阈值处理的抖动图案之间毫无关联。这会产生相互冲突的视觉线索，还会造成闪烁

cues.en: and play testers found it unpleasant to look at. Lucas wanted to fix this by making the dither pattern be pinned to the geometry
cues.zh: 试玩者觉得看起来很别扭。Lucas 想通过把抖动图案固定到几何体上来解决这个问题，

cues.en: and to appear stable as it moves with the rest of the scene.
cues.zh: 并让它随场景其余部分一起移动时显得稳定。

cues.en: In one of his attempts to achieve this, he tried to just map the dither patterns to the textile space of the scene geometry directly.
cues.zh: 在他为实现这一目标所做的其中一次尝试中，他试着把抖动图案直接映射到场景几何体的纹理空间上。

cues.en: But as he had expected, it didn't work well.
cues.zh: 但正如他所料，效果并不好。

cues.en: The tilt patterns
cues.zh: 这些倾斜图案

cues.en: would vary in size based on how close the geometry was to the camera and also based on the specifics of their scale and UV mapping.
cues.zh: 会随着几何体离相机的远近而变化大小，也会因它们自身的缩放和 UV 映射的具体情况而不同。

cues.en: While inconsistency
cues.zh: 虽然这种不一致

cues.en: of scale and UV mapping might be fixable with a lot of work, the issue with the variable distance to the camera was inherent and could not be worked around. Dither patterns just have to have a consistent scale on the screen in order to be effective.
cues.zh: 在缩放和 UV 映射方面也许投入大量工作还能修好，但相机距离变化带来的问题是固有的，无法绕开。抖动图案必须在屏幕上保持一致的尺度，才能发挥作用。

cues.en: Lucas eventually came up with the idea to map the dither pattern to a sphere centered around the player's head. This way, the dither is pinned to the geometry during camera rotation,
cues.zh: Lucas 最终想到一个办法：把抖动图案映射到以玩家头部为中心的球面上。这样，在相机旋转时，抖动会固定在几何体上，

cues.en: but not during camera translation.
cues.zh: 但在相机平移时则不会。

cues.en: This was a compromise,
cues.zh: 这是一种折中，

cues.en: but one he found quite acceptable and a good fit for the game. And I think it was a good choice. The game looks great,
cues.zh: 但他觉得相当可以接受，也很适合这款游戏。我认为这是个好选择。游戏看起来很棒，

cues.en: but it did plant a seed of an idea in my head.
cues.zh: 但它确实在我脑中埋下了一个想法的种子。

cues.en: Would it be possible to somehow make a dither pattern that would be stable even on the camera translation,
cues.zh: 有没有可能做出某种抖动图案，即使摄像机平移也能保持稳定，

cues.en: yet have a consistent scale on the screen?
cues.zh: 同时在屏幕上保持一致的尺度？

cues.en: I had a feeling it should be possible.
cues.zh: 我感觉这应该是可行的。

cues.en: Five years later, I randomly decided one day to just try it out. I set up a simple test scene. For the dither pattern, I'm just using a radial gradient for a start. As we have seen earlier, this can be used for halftone dither ring, but I'll wait a bit with the shading part and just focus on stable dots for now. The basic idea is this.
cues.zh: 五年后，我某天随手决定试一试。我搭了一个简单的测试场景。抖动图案先用径向渐变凑合。正如我们之前看到的，这可以用于半色调抖动环，不过着色部分先放一放，现在只关注稳定点。基本思路是这样。

cues.en: We start with the approach of mapping a dither pattern to the textile space of the scene geometry.
cues.zh: 我们从把抖动图案映射到场景几何的纺织品空间这一方法开始。

cues.en: That is to use the object's own UV mapping for the dither pattern. UV mapping, for those who don't know, is a common method in three d graphics to encode in a three d model how a two d image should be mapped onto its surface. We can change the tiling frequency of the pattern,
cues.zh: 也就是用对象自身的 UV 映射来做抖动图案。UV 映射，给不了解的人解释一下，是三维图形学里一种常见方法，用来在三维模型中编码二维图像应如何映射到其表面。我们可以改变图案的平铺频率，

cues.en: but it doesn't really help.
cues.zh: 但这其实没什么帮助。

cues.en: As Lucas found, mapping the dithered pattern to the geometry using UV mapping results in the pattern sometimes being scaled too small and sometimes too large. My core idea for how to fix this is to just compensate.
cues.zh: 正如 Lucas 发现的，用 UV 映射把抖动图案映射到几何体上，会导致图案有时被缩得太小，有时又太大。我修复这个问题的核心思路就是直接做补偿。

cues.en: Whenever the pattern becomes two times too large, we make it half the scale. And whenever it becomes two times too small, we make it twice the scale. We can do this because we can calculate the rate of change of the UV coordinates in the shader. We can round this rate of change to the nearest power of two value. This means we round it to a new value whenever the rate of change becomes twice as big or twice as small.
cues.zh: 每当图案变得大了两倍，我们就将缩放减半；每当它变得小了两倍，我们就将缩放加倍。之所以能这样做，是因为我们可以在着色器中计算 UV 坐标的变化率。我们可以把这个变化率舍入到最接近的 2 的幂值。也就是说，每当变化率变大到两倍或变小到一半，我们就把它舍入到一个新值。

cues.en: We can then calculate modified UV coordinates that are divided by this value.
cues.zh: 然后我们可以算出将这些 UV 坐标除以该值后得到的修改版 UV 坐标。

cues.en: If we map the dither pattern to these modified UV coordinates, we can see that it abruptly changes between different scales.
cues.zh: 如果把抖动图案映射到这些修改后的 UV 坐标上，可以看到它在不同缩放级别之间会发生突变。

cues.en: But these different scales are all roughly the same size on the screen, bearing only up to a factor of two.
cues.zh: 但在屏幕上，这些不同缩放级别的大小大致相同，最多只相差两倍。

cues.en: The next step from here is to remove the abruptness between the different scales.
cues.zh: 接下来要做的是消除不同缩放级别之间的突变。

cues.en: Maybe you're wondering why we apply rounding to the rate of change in the first place. Why not just divide the modified UV coordinates with the rate of change directly?
cues.zh: 你可能会想，我们一开始为什么要对变化率做舍入？为什么不直接把修改后的 UV 坐标除以变化率呢？

cues.en: Well, when you scale a pattern continuously,
cues.zh: 那么，当你连续缩放一个图案时，

cues.en: the details in the pattern necessarily move around as a result.
cues.zh: 图案中的细节必然会随之移动。

cues.en: But we don't want them to move around. We want them to be pinned to the surface of the geometry.
cues.zh: 但我们不希望它们移动。我们希望它们固定在几何体的表面上。

cues.en: So we have to find another way.
cues.zh: 所以我们必须另想办法。

cues.en: A way where you can keep zooming in on the pattern and it just keeps revealing more and more dots, kind of like in a fractal.
cues.zh: 一种让你可以不断放大图案，而它只会揭示出越来越多点的方式，有点像分形。

cues.en: Alright. We have to take a step back again and talk more about the type of order dithering
cues.zh: 好。我们得再退一步，多谈谈这种有序抖动

cues.en: that's based on a Bayer threshold map.
cues.zh: 它是基于 Bayer 阈值图的。

cues.en: The most basic form of Bayer threshold map is a two by two Bayer matrix.
cues.zh: Bayer 阈值图最基本的形式是一个 2×2 的 Bayer 矩阵。

cues.en: The four cells in the matrix represent increasing threshold values and the order is important.
cues.zh: 矩阵中的四个单元格表示递增的阈值，顺序很重要。

cues.en: Well, it's not important which one you choose as the first one and in fact, it's also not important which one you choose as the third and fourth ones.
cues.zh: 其实选哪个作为第一个并不重要，选哪个作为第三和第四个也不重要。

cues.en: But the second one must be diagonally opposite the first. So, if we connect the four points, they trace an x.
cues.zh: 但第二个必须与第一个斜对。所以，如果连接这四个点，它们会构成一个 X。

cues.en: With this threshold map of four cells, you can represent five different shades corresponding to zero, one, two, three, or all four of the thresholds being exceeded.
cues.zh: 借助这张包含四个格子的阈值图，可以表示五种不同的明暗，分别对应超过零个、一个、两个、三个或全部四个阈值的情况。

cues.en: But you can construct larger Beyer matrices too that can represent a larger amount of different shades. The next common one is a four by four Beyer matrix, which has 16 cells and can thus represent
cues.zh: 但你也可以构造更大的 Beyer 矩阵，来表示更多不同的明暗层次。下一个常见的是 4×4 的 Beyer 矩阵，它有 16 个格子，因此能表示

cues.en: 17 different shades.
cues.zh: 17 种不同的明暗。

cues.en: What's the order in this one? Well, you start with the same order from the two by two matrix,
cues.zh: 这个矩阵的顺序是什么？从 2×2 矩阵的同一顺序开始，

cues.en: which trace an x. Just spread out twice as much. Then you copy paste that three more times. And the order in which you paste them also trace the same x.
cues.zh: 它们勾勒出一个 X 形。只要把间距扩大一倍，然后把它再复制粘贴三次；粘贴它们的顺序也同样勾勒出同一个 X 形。

cues.en: And you can use the exact same steps to expand to an even larger eight by eight b matrix which has six four cells and thus can represent 65
cues.zh: 你可以用完全相同的步骤扩展到更大的 8×8 矩阵，它有 64 个格子，因此能表示 65

cues.en: shades. Start with a pattern from the four by four matrix spread out twice as much and paste it three more times tracing out the same old x. We can keep repeating this indefinitely
cues.zh: 种灰度。先从 4×4 矩阵中取一个图案，把间距拉开一倍，再粘贴三次，沿同样的 X 形轨迹描出。我们可以这样无限重复下去

cues.en: filling in more and more cells in between the existing ones.
cues.zh: 在已有格子之间填入越来越多的格子。

cues.en: You see how the Bayer order differ pattern already has fractal like properties to begin with?
cues.zh: 你看，Bayer 有序抖动图案本身从一开始就具有类似分形的性质吧？

cues.en: This is something we can work with.
cues.zh: 这个我们可以利用。

cues.en: Let's go back to our work in progress. I'm going to start referring to the different scales as different fractal levels.
cues.zh: 回到我们正在做的工作。接下来我会把不同的尺度称为不同的分形层级。

cues.en: The more you zoom in, the lower fractal levels you reach.
cues.zh: 越放大，到达的分形层级就越低。

cues.en: We can see that one dot kind of splits into four smaller dots when it crosses the threshold to a lower fractal level where the pattern is half the scale.
cues.zh: 可以看到，当一个点越过阈值、进入图案尺度减半的更低分形层级时，它有点像分裂成四个更小的点。

cues.en: If we just shift the radial gradient to be centered around the corner of the texture instead of the center, we can change the behavior so it appears like the big dot stays as one dot across the fractal level threshold.
cues.zh: 如果我们把径向渐变的中心从纹理中心移到纹理角落，就能改变效果，让大点跨过分形层级阈值时看起来仍是一个点。

cues.en: It just becomes smaller and is joined by additional small dots around it.
cues.zh: 它只是变得更小，周围还会加入一些额外的小点。

cues.en: This hearkens back to the Bayer matrices where we constructed a larger Bayer matrix by filling in additional cells in between the ones we had reused from a smaller Bayer matrix.
cues.zh: 这要回溯到 Bayer 矩阵：我们通过在从较小 Bayer 矩阵复用的单元格之间填入额外单元格，构造出更大的 Bayer 矩阵。

cues.en: Now, if we could make the three additional dots appear one by one instead of all at once, that would be even better.
cues.zh: 现在，如果我们能让额外三个点逐个出现，而不是一次性全部出现，那就更好了。

cues.en: So far, we've had fractal levels where each lower level is half the scale, which means it has four times as many dots.
cues.zh: 到目前为止，我们处理的分形层级中，每低一层尺度减半，这意味着点数会变成四倍。

cues.en: Conceptually,
cues.zh: 从概念上讲，

cues.en: we now want to split each fractal level into multiple layers where we can add one more dot in each layer.
cues.zh: 我们现在想把每个分形层级拆成多个层，并在每层中多加一个点。

cues.en: And, of course, we use the ordering from the Bayer matrices to do it, tracing the familiar x. The dots in the lower fractal level are half as big, well, the radius is. The area of each dot is a quarter as big. And there are four times as many dots.
cues.zh: 当然，我们使用 Bayer 矩阵中的顺序来完成，沿着熟悉的 x 轨迹。较低分形层级中的点只有一半大，准确说是半径减半。每个点的面积变为四分之一。而点的数量是四倍。

cues.en: We can generalize this across the layers by having the dot area
cues.zh: 我们可以让点的面积

cues.en: inversely proportional to the number of dots. Now, both the positions and sizes of the dots are identical between the last layer of one fractal level and the first layer of the fractal level below it. So how do we implement these layers exactly?
cues.zh: 与点的数量成反比，从而在各层间推广这一点。现在，在一个分形层级的最后一层与其下一分形层级的第一层之间，点的位置和大小都完全相同。那么，我们到底该如何实现这些层呢？

cues.en: So far, we've been using a regular texture for our dither pattern, but modern three d graphics support a different data structure called a three d texture.
cues.zh: 到目前为止，我们一直用普通纹理来做抖动图案，但现代 3D 图形支持一种不同的数据结构，叫做 3D 纹理。

cues.en: Besides a width and a height, three d textures also have a depth dimension.
cues.zh: 除了宽度和高度，3D 纹理还有一个深度维度。

cues.en: They can be used for many things, but we are going to treat the three d texture like a stack of two d layers so we can add one more dot in each layer.
cues.zh: 它们有很多用途，不过我们打算把 3D 纹理当作一叠 2D 层来处理，这样就能在每一层里多加一个点。

cues.en: I'll skip over how the three d texture is created, but I've essentially written a piece of code to do it. Now, we have our sub layers for each fractal level, but how do we determine which layer to use? We have to dive into some math for this, but I'll promise I'll do it quick.
cues.zh: 我会跳过 3D 纹理的创建过程，但我基本已经写好了一段代码来做这件事。现在，每个分形层级都有了对应的子层，可我们怎么决定用哪一层呢？这得深入一点数学，但我保证会很快讲完。

cues.en: Let's first catch up on what we've been already doing so far, but now in math terms.
cues.zh: 我们先回顾一下到目前为止已经做过的事，不过这次用数学语言来讲。

cues.en: To begin with, we have the rate of change, the frequency
cues.zh: 首先，我们有变化率，也就是频率

cues.en: of the UV coordinates.
cues.zh: UV 坐标的频率。

cues.en: We need to find the nearest lower power of two.
cues.zh: 我们需要找到最接近且不超过它的 2 的幂。

cues.en: The first step of this is to take the logarithm with base two of the frequency.
cues.zh: 第一步是对频率取以 2 为底的对数。

cues.en: You'll notice that when the frequency doubles,
cues.zh: 你会注意到，当频率翻倍时，

cues.en: the logarithm of the frequency grows by one. So when the frequency is two, four, eight and sixteen,
cues.zh: 频率的对数会增加一。所以当频率是 2、4、8、16 时，

cues.en: the logarithm of it is one, two, three and four. We can round the logarithm down to the nearest lower whole number.
cues.zh: 它的对数就是 1、2、3、4。我们可以把对数向下取整到最接近的较小整数。

cues.en: This number corresponds to the fracture levels we've been talking about.
cues.zh: 这个数字对应我们之前讨论过的裂缝层级。

cues.en: For each lower fracture level, the pattern needs to be scaled twice as small, so we need to divide the UV coordinates with twice as small numbers.
cues.zh: 对于每一个更低的裂缝层级，图案都需要缩小到原来的一半，所以我们要把 UV 坐标除以缩小一半的数值。

cues.en: This creates UV coordinates which change with a higher frequency,
cues.zh: 这会生成变化频率更高的 UV 坐标，

cues.en: which in turn results in a smaller scale pattern.
cues.zh: 进而得到尺度更小的图案。

cues.en: Our last step to achieve this is to raise the number two to the power of our rounded logarithm.
cues.zh: 实现这一点的最后一步，是计算 2 的取整对数次幂。

cues.en: This is essentially the inverse of taking the logarithm.
cues.zh: 这基本上就是取对数的逆运算。

cues.en: Then we have our nearest lower power of two that we can divide the UV coordinates with.
cues.zh: 然后我们找到最接近且不超过它的 2 的幂，用这个值来除 UV 坐标。

cues.en: With the UV coordinates out of the way, let's go back to the logarithmic space. We can subtract the rounded logarithm curve from the unrounded
cues.zh: UV 坐标搞定了，我们回到对数空间。把取整后的对数曲线从未取整的对数曲线中减去

cues.en: logarithm curve to get the remainder.
cues.zh: 就能得到余数。

cues.en: This remainder increases from zero to one within each fractal level. And this is what we can use to determine which sub layer to use within the fractal level.
cues.zh: 这个余数在每个分形层级内都从 0 增大到 1。我们正好可以用它来确定该使用分形层级中的哪个子层。

cues.en: Now that we know what layer in our three d texture to use at any given point, we have achieved the effect we wanted, that more dots keep appearing little by little as you zoom in more and more. It's still a bit coarse though. We can have the dots appear more gradually by using a dither pattern with more dots in it. The one we used so far corresponded to a two by two biometrics,
cues.zh: 既然我们知道在任意位置该使用 3D 纹理中的哪一层，就实现了想要的效果：随着你不断放大，越来越多的点会一点一点出现。不过它还是有点粗糙。我们可以使用包含更多点的抖动图案，让点出现得更渐进。我们目前用的对应一个 2×2 的 Bayer 矩阵，

cues.en: but we can also generate a three d texture based on a four by four biometrics
cues.zh: 但也可以基于 4×4 的 Bayer 矩阵生成 3D 纹理

cues.en: or an eight by eight bare matrix. Beyond that, we get diminishing returns which are not worth it. One interesting thing about using dither patterns larger than two by two for fractal dithering is that we are actually leaving a bit under a quarter of the layers unused.
cues.zh: 或者 8×8 的 Bayer 矩阵。再往上，收益递减，不值得。使用大于 2×2 的抖动图案做分形抖动时，有个有趣的地方：我们实际上会剩下略少于四分之一的层没用到。

cues.en: For example, if we're using four by four dots, we only use the layers that have four to 16 dots.
cues.zh: 比如，如果我们用的是 4×4 的点，就只使用包含 4 到 16 个点的层。

cues.en: We don't need the layers with one to three dots since at that point, we are switching to a different fracture level instead.
cues.zh: 我们不需要只有 1 到 3 个点的层，因为到那个阶段，我们会改用另一个分形层级。

cues.en: Anyway, look at the dots we got now. They look nice and even regardless of scale and distance from the camera.
cues.zh: 总之，看看现在得到的点。无论缩放比例和离相机的距离如何，它们看起来都很漂亮、均匀。

cues.en: But something is missing.
cues.zh: 但还少了点什么。

cues.en: Ah, yes, the shading.
cues.zh: 啊，对了，是明暗。

cues.en: The shading
cues.zh: 明暗

cues.en: which is the whole point of using dithering.
cues.zh: 而这正是使用抖动的关键所在。

cues.en: We should probably fix that.
cues.zh: 我们大概得把那个问题修一下。

cues.en: Normally,
cues.zh: 通常情况下，

cues.en: when you use a Bayer threshold map, switching over more of its cells from black to white implies changing the perceived shading to be brighter.
cues.zh: 使用 Bayer 阈值图时，把更多单元格从黑切换成白，意味着感知到的明暗会变得更亮。

cues.en: But in our case so far, we've been adding more dots simply to control the density of the dots across different zoom levels, so the density can be roughly constant on the screen.
cues.zh: 但到目前为止，在我们的场景里，增加更多点只是为了控制不同缩放级别下的点密度，让屏幕上的密度大致保持恒定。

cues.en: But I said from the beginning that I used a radial gradient, so I could use it for halftone dehering, where the dot sizes are varied to produce different shades.
cues.zh: 但我一开始就说过，我用了径向渐变，所以可以把它用于半色调抖动，通过改变点的大小来产生不同的色调。

cues.en: Even though we've since changed the pattern, we still have a radial gradient for each dot and we can still vary the sizes of the dots from the screen by changing the threshold value we use.
cues.zh: 尽管后来我们改了图案，每个点仍然有径向渐变，而且仍可通过改变所用的阈值来调整屏幕上点的大小。

cues.en: If we set the threshold to be one minus the image brightness, the result is that brighter parts of the image have larger white dots.
cues.zh: 如果把阈值设为一减去图像亮度，结果就是图像较亮的部分会有更大的白点。

cues.en: Okay. So now we have a form of surface stable fractal dillering where the pattern looks like Bayer threshold maps, but the shading looks like halftone.
cues.zh: 好，现在我们有了一种表面稳定的分形抖动：图案看起来像 Bayer 阈值图，但明暗看起来像半色调。

cues.en: And that's perfectly fine in its own way, a valid aesthetic.
cues.zh: 这本身其实也完全没问题，是一种合理的美学。

cues.en: But it wasn't quite the style of dithering I had in mind.
cues.zh: 但这不太是我想要的那种抖动风格。

cues.en: Rather than producing different shades by varying the dot sizes,
cues.zh: 与其通过改变点的大小来产生不同色调，

cues.en: I wanted to produce different shades by having more or fewer dots, more similar in look to classic Bayer dillering.
cues.zh: 我想通过增加或减少点的数量来产生不同色调，外观上更接近经典的 Bayer 抖动。

cues.en: So let's forget the halftone dillering where the dot sizes are controlled by the brightness.
cues.zh: 所以先忘掉半色调抖动——那种用亮度控制点大小的做法。

cues.en: It's not what we need. How can we control the dot density instead?
cues.zh: 那不是我们需要的。我们该如何改为控制点的密度？

cues.en: I want to quickly show you something. Like I said earlier, the dithering is ultimately based on UV coordinates.
cues.zh: 我想快速给你们展示点东西。就像我之前说的，抖动最终是基于 UV 坐标的。

cues.en: If we multiply the UV coordinates with the global scale factor, we can control the overall pattern scale.
cues.zh: 如果把 UV 坐标乘以全局缩放因子，就能控制图案的整体缩放。

cues.en: Changing it does make the dots move around, but it's meant to be something you just set once and for all to control the overall aesthetic of the dithering,
cues.zh: 改动它确实会让点移动，但它本来是一次性设定好、用来控制抖动整体视觉效果的，

cues.en: not something to be changed on the fly.
cues.zh: 而不是用来在运行时动态修改的。

cues.en: Then again, it could be fun if we could make the dots stable even while changing the scale. What if we instead multiply the global scale factor onto the UV frequency?
cues.zh: 不过话说回来，如果能在改变缩放时仍让圆点保持稳定，那会很有意思。要是改为把全局缩放因子乘到 UV 频率上呢？

cues.en: This actually works great.
cues.zh: 这效果确实很好。

cues.en: We can now change the scale factor on the fly while still keeping the dots stable.
cues.zh: 现在我们可以动态改变缩放因子，同时仍让圆点保持稳定。

cues.en: This got me thinking,
cues.zh: 这让我想到，

cues.en: what if we divide the UV frequency by the image brightness?
cues.zh: 如果把 UV 频率除以图像亮度会怎样？

cues.en: This should make the spacing smaller where the image is brighter.
cues.zh: 这样在图像更亮的地方，间距应该会更小。

cues.en: This does indeed work, kind of. The dot spacing does become smaller where the image is supposed to be bright, but unfortunately,
cues.zh: 这确实有点效果。在图像本该明亮的区域，点间距确实变小了，但不幸的是，

cues.en: the dots themselves also become smaller.
cues.zh: 点本身也变小了。

cues.en: If only we had a way to control only the spacing without affecting the dot sizes.
cues.zh: 要是能有办法只控制间距、不影响点的大小就好了。

cues.en: But this is very elusive.
cues.zh: 但这非常难以实现。

cues.en: So far, we only have two experiments
cues.zh: 到目前为止，我们只有两个实验方案

cues.en: which both affect the dot sizes.
cues.zh: 而它们都会影响点的大小。

cues.en: We can divide the UV frequency with the brightness to make brighter shades have smaller spacing, but also smaller dots.
cues.zh: 我们可以把 UV 频率除以亮度，让更亮的色调拥有更小的间距，但点也会更小。

cues.en: Or we can set the threshold to one minus the brightness to get halftone dithering where brighter shades have larger dots.
cues.zh: 或者把阈值设为 1 减去亮度，就能得到半色调抖动，其中越亮的色调点越大。

cues.en: Wait a minute.
cues.zh: 等一下。

cues.en: Smaller white dots,
cues.zh: 更小的白点，

cues.en: larger white dots. Dots.
cues.zh: 更大的白点。点。

cues.en: What if we apply both at the same time?
cues.zh: 如果同时应用两者会怎样？

cues.en: So the smaller white dots and the larger white dots cancel out.
cues.zh: 这样较小的白点和较大的白点就会相互抵消。

cues.en: Hey, this actually works.
cues.zh: 嘿，这还真行。

cues.en: Now we've got smaller dot spacing where the image is brighter, but the dots still stay the same size.
cues.zh: 现在图像越亮的地方点间距越小，但点的大小仍然不变。

cues.en: It works so seamlessly that you can't tell it's achieved by making the pattern scale smaller,
cues.zh: 它运行得如此无缝，你根本看不出这是靠缩小图案比例实现的，

cues.en: except if we enable a debug overlay to visualize the pattern size.
cues.zh: 除非我们开启调试叠加层来可视化图案大小。

cues.en: So there you have it. That's the basics of how surface stable fractal dillering works.
cues.zh: 所以就是这样。这就是表面稳定的分形抖动的基本原理。

cues.en: I left out a lot of details, especially regarding how to get perfect angializing for the dots.
cues.zh: 我省略了很多细节，尤其是如何让这些点获得完美的抗锯齿效果。

cues.en: But I've released the shader code and example project as open source and added lots of comments to the shader. So if you want, you can study the finer details there. See the links in the description.
cues.zh: 但我已将着色器代码和示例项目开源，并在着色器中添加了大量注释。所以如果你愿意，可以在那里研究更细的细节。详见描述中的链接。

cues.en: What about the return of the Oprah Dinn?
cues.zh: 那 Oprah Dinn 的回归呢？

cues.en: Do I think that my dithering technique would have been superior to use in that game?
cues.zh: 我认为在那款游戏里用我的抖动技术会更好吗？

cues.en: Not really.
cues.zh: 并不觉得。

cues.en: Like I said, I think it looked great the way it was, and I wouldn't really want to change anything about it. Apart from that, there are some issues I never managed to solve.
cues.zh: 就像我说的，我觉得它原来的样子看起来很棒，我也不太想改任何地方。除此之外，还有一些我一直没能解决的问题。

cues.en: While the dot spacing is roughly constant under arbitrary uniform scaling,
cues.zh: 虽然点间距在任意均匀缩放下大致恒定，

cues.en: it's not constant on a non uniform scaling or when viewing surfaces at shallow angles. In other words, when the UV frequency is anisotropic.
cues.zh: 但在非均匀缩放下，或以浅角度观察表面时，它并不恒定。换句话说，当 UV 频率各向异性时。

cues.en: Here, the dots clump together in one direction, and at the extreme, they tend to form lines almost like a woodcut.
cues.zh: 这里，这些点朝着同一个方向聚集成团，在极端情况下，它们会几乎连成线条，像木版画一样。

cues.en: I don't think this looks bad per se. This too is a valid static,
cues.zh: 我本人并不觉得这难看。这同样也是一种有效的静态效果，

cues.en: but it doesn't look like the Bayer dithering my technique was inspired by.
cues.zh: 但它看起来不像启发我这项技术的 Bayer 抖动。

cues.en: But what does surface stable fractal dithering look like in an actual game?
cues.zh: 但表面稳定的分形抖动在实际游戏里是什么样子呢？

cues.en: For fun, I tried to apply the technique to my old game eye of the temple. I made several shader types to cover various solid and transparent surfaces as well as the skybox.
cues.zh: 出于好玩，我试着把这项技术用到我的旧游戏《Eye of the Temple》上。我制作了几种着色器类型，以覆盖各种实体和透明表面以及天空盒。

cues.en: They all use the same shader include file, which contains the actual dithering logic.
cues.zh: 它们都使用同一个着色器包含文件，里面包含实际的抖动逻辑。

cues.en: I think it looks kinda neat.
cues.zh: 我觉得看起来还挺不错。

cues.en: So am I going to use this for my own games?
cues.zh: 那我会把这个用在自己的游戏里吗？

cues.en: No. Well, fun to try out. It's not a good fit for my games.
cues.zh: 不会。不过，试试挺有意思。它不太适合我的游戏。

cues.en: The whole project was just an interesting diversion for me.
cues.zh: 整个项目对我来说只是一次有趣的消遣。

cues.en: Speaking of my own games, I am still working on The Big Forest despite not having made any new videos about it in the past year. For anyone interested,
cues.zh: 说到我自己的游戏，我还在开发 The Big Forest，尽管过去一年没发过关于它的新视频。感兴趣的话，

cues.en: I do have a few blog posts on my website about what I've been up to development wise.
cues.zh: 我网站上确实有几篇博客文章，讲我开发方面一直在做什么。

cues.en: Alright. That's it for now. If you like the video, you can click the like button. And if you want to see more, consider subscribing.
cues.zh: 好了，今天就到这里。喜欢这个视频的话可以点个赞，想看更多的话可以考虑订阅。

cues.en: Till next time. Bye.
cues.zh: 下次见。拜拜。
